This is the only DAG engine.\n---\n\nEach project may carry an **hgraph**: a plain-files semantic graph under\n`<project>/hgraph/` — one Markdown node per blueprint statement and per Lean\ndeclaration, typed edges (`uses` = the hard dependency DAG, `formalizes` =\ninformal↔formal identity). `horizon graph sync` (run automatically at run boundaries)\nreconciles the blueprint + Lean sources into it; your **authored** additions\n(comments, reviews, metadata) are never touched by sync. The files are\ncommitted to the workspace ledger like everything else.\n\nUse `\"$HORIZON_BIN\" graph -p <project> …`; when a workspace has one project,\n`-p` is optional. Address nodes by `label:<latex-label>` or\n`decl:<lean-fqname>` — raw ids are opaque hashes. Most commands accept `--json`.\n\n## Sync it yourself — and act on the warnings\n\nDon't wait for the run boundary: after you change blueprint statements,\n`\\uses{}`/`\\lean{}` annotations, or Lean declarations, run\n`\"$HORIZON_BIN\" graph -p <project> sync` and **read its output**. Sync prints warnings for exactly the defects\nyou can fix on the spot: `\\uses{X} has no blueprint node` (missing/mistyped\nlabel), `\\lean{Name} not found in Lean sources` (renamed or unwritten\ndeclaration), stale nodes whose source vanished. store = _store(ctx)
    actor = author or agent_author("human")
    project_tuple = tuple(projects) if projects else (project,)
    task = HorizonTask(
        id=task_id,
        project=project,
        objective=objective,
        title=title or objective,
        projects=project_tuple,
        priority=priority,
        status=TaskStatus(status.lower()),
        write_set=WriteSet(projects=project_tuple, files=tuple(files or ())),
        scope=ItemScope(projects=project_tuple, files=tuple(files or ())),
        metadata=with_provenance({"author": actor} if actor else {}),
    )
    store.put(task)
    store.append_history(task_id, history_entry(actor, "created", after=task.status.value, note="opened"))
    tasks = store.list()
    if as_json:
        emit_json(_with_task_warnings(_task_dict(task), tasks))
        return
    log.success(f"Added task {task_id}.")
    _warn_tasks(tasks)

) -> None:

    actor = author or agent_author()

        raise typer.BadParameter(str(exc)) from exc
    store.add_comment(task_id, body, actor, with_provenance())
    tasks = store.list()
    if as_json:
        emit_json(_with_task_warnings({"id": task_id, "commented": True}, tasks))
        return
    log.success(f"Commented on task {task_id}.")
    _warn_tasks(tasks)

    store.delete(task_id)
    log.success(f"Removed task {task_id}.")
    _warn_tasks(store.list())
